Hi, I am Rahul Nair. Online, I usually go by `unrahul`.

Most of what I write starts with something I can run and measure. Lately that
has meant Intel GPUs, inference servers, kernels, and model internals. I keep
enough detail that someone else can reproduce the work, including the
measurements that changed my mind. Older notes cover Rust, machine learning,
and the occasional not-so-technical detour.

The image on the left came from an early Stable Diffusion experiment with this
prompt:

> Dalí designing a cyberpunk version of a dream he had about a futuristic
> microprocessor.
